slices.focus: After two pilot visits, Colleen shifts from testing to actively marketing the school program.
slices.summary: Two pilot visits (one district, one charter) give Colleen critical feedback: teachers care most about standards alignment, price options, and bus logistics, not just the content. She rewrites the packet into a teacher-facing menu, gets Leonard's approval for a wider outreach email, and prepares follow-up templates. The work shifts from 'can I build this' to 'will anyone adopt it,' which feels more vulnerable but more honest.
open_loops: Outreach email needs final subject line and lead paragraph -- resisting the urge to cram everything in
Follow-up templates need drafting before sending
District vs charter audience may need slightly different messaging
decisions: Colleen moved the museum's school initiative from a structured pilot into active marketing, with a tested curriculum-ali
